_readme: S402 SkyToyon, 2026-10-17. Two registry rows name a page about the catalog where the harvest needs the catalog itself (handoff 402 priority 4). Copper Mountain's row names https://www.cmccd.edu/academic-catalogs/ (the census read 'curriqunet' from that page's text only, 2026-2027 in its body); San Diego College of Continuing Education's names the district's College Catalogs page (sdccd.edu), also 'curriqunet' from text only. Precedent: S371 corrected San Diego Mesa's row from the SDCCD curriQunet host's own catalog list (_getCatalogs names City 69, Mesa 70, Miramar 71). Three loads, no model call: each page's catalog links, and the SDCCD host's catalog list.

questions.cmc_catalog: Where Copper Mountain's 2026-2027 catalog lives: the href of each catalog link on its Catalogs page (a curriQunet host, a PDF, another platform).
questions.sdcce_catalog: Whether the district's College Catalogs page links a Continuing Education catalog, and its href.
questions.sdccd_list: Whether sdccd.curriqunet.com's own catalog list names a Continuing Education catalog for 2026-2027: its Id and Title.
